scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @stratton/contracts && npm run build --workspace @stratton/scenario-data
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace @stratton/demo-bff && npm run build --workspace @stratton/demo-web
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test:workspaces && npm run test:scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
